definitions.citation_count: the study work's OpenAlex cited_by_count as the v4 neighbour-selection manifest records it (study_works.<paper>.cited_by_count, from the corpus builder's OpenAlex work lookup, identical to the v1 manifest's); §7 R6 citation-count tercile
definitions.tercile_cuts: per variable, over the study papers with a value: c1 = v_(ceil(n/3)), c2 = v_(ceil(2n/3)) of the ascending values (the inverse empirical CDF, Hyndman-Fan type 1), read by the statistics as T1: v <= c1; T2: c1 < v <= c2; T3: v > c2 (§7 R6). The prereg fixes the variables and that cuts are committed, not the quantile convention; type 1 is the builder's choice (DEVIATIONS D-1)
definitions.text_similarity: mean cosine similarity of the stored SFR-Embedding-Mistral vectors (ops/emb, the served embedder) over every pair (i, j), i a chunk of the study paper in the base export, j a chunk of one of its attributed neighbour papers in the v4 neighbour chunk file; equals (sum_i u_i) . (sum_j u_j) / (n_i n_j) with u the unit vectors; null for a study paper with no attributed neighbour; §7 R6 text-similarity tercile

rule: T1: v <= c1; T2: c1 < v <= c2; T3: v > c2 (alias_study_stats.TERCILE_RULE)
